title: Rav Ada bar Avimi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: (An Amora in the Land of Israel, of the fourth generation.) He was a student of Rabbi Chanina (a colleague of the Rabbis): [Eruvin 9b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.9b.12) has him reciting before him, and [12a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.12a.11) has the alternative “before Rabbi Chanina bar Papi.” Yuchasin read Abba bar Avimi; [Rashi on 14b](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Eruvin.14b.17.1), under mishum, has Ada bar Menyumi. He was also Rabbi Zeira’s student, and Rabbi Chizkiyah and Rabbi Nachum were his colleagues, as at the end of [Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Berakhot.9.2.20). For the parallel in Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:3, Hyman gives bar Ivuma and proposes bar Avimi.

notes.text: חברון דרבנן describes Chanina as a colleague of the Rabbis; it does not identify a Hebron rabbinic circle. Ada/Abba, Avimi/Ivuma and Menyumi remain Hyman’s reported variants.

The linked Bavli passages have Ada bar Avimi, with Chanina bar Pappi as an alternative in the second passage. Rashi has Ada bar Menyumi. The linked Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot has bar Avimi; its [Taanit parallel](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Taanit.1.3.3) reads bar Ikhuma in Hebrew, while the accompanying English proposes Avimi. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=210&lang=en) also reports the Abba variant and the two names in the Yerushalmi.
